factsAndSources.requirement: Independent fact/quotation audit against actually inspected sources; schema integrity alone does not score this dimension.

narrative.requirement: Independent narrative review; reader inspiration is separate unmeasured research.

visualReading.requirement: Independent real-frame review at four sizes, with screenshots.

workRelationships.requirement: Verify testimony, documented connection, interpretation and contemporary context, including edition chronology.

tools.requirement: Real host invocation plus deterministic isolation/CAS/cancellation regressions; report separately.

searchGeneration.requirement: Actual unseen-person directory searches, registered source reading and metered official DSH generation.

languagesAccessibility.requirement: Four locale UI/content inspection, keyboard, large text and reduced-motion checks; native-speaker and screen-reader limits explicit.

sharingBoundaries.requirement: Public/private projection, export reload, share revocation and cancellation recovery.

performanceRecovery.requirement: Measure cached page and cold generation independently; timeout/offline/revocation behavior.

scoreRule: Unmeasured dimensions remain unmeasured. No overall score until all nine have evidence. Overall >98.0 and every dimension >=95 required. Deterministic pass rates never become aesthetic scores.
